Frequently Asked Questions
Common questions about Curve Dental's valuation, stock price, and market status.
Is Curve Dental a public or private company?
Curve Dental is a private company.What is the current stock price of Curve Dental?
Curve Dental is a private company, so its shares have no public market price. Caplight tracks Curve Dental's secondary market activity and provides MarketPrice™ estimates of its share price to Caplight users.How much is Curve Dental worth (valuation)?
Valuation information for Curve Dental is not publicly available.Can I buy Curve Dental stock?
Curve Dental shares may be available on secondary markets subject to transfer restrictions. Caplight facilitates secondary market transactions for accredited investors.When was Curve Dental's last funding round?
Curve Dental's most recent funding round was Growth Equity on February 8, 2018.Who are the main investors in Curve Dental?
Key investors in Curve Dental include Battery Ventures.Will Curve Dental IPO soon?
